summary: Frontend testing of Appointments Module (8 critical issues). Verified component structure, data-testids, and UI elements via Expo web tunnel. Found several critical issues requiring main agent attention.

ui_bugs.issue: i18n keys NOT translated - showing raw keys like 'APPOINTMENTS.VISITHISTORY', 'APPOINTMENTS.APPOINTMENTDETAILS', 'APPOINTMENTS.QUICKACTIONS', 'appointments.reschedule', 'appointments.noShow'
Client phone NOT visible in list cards - only shows time, client name, staff name, status badge. Quick action buttons (Call, WhatsApp) NOT visible in UI
WhatsApp button in header NOT visible - code has data-testid='detail-whatsapp-button' but not rendering
Treatment and Staff info NOT visible in Appointment Info section - only shows Date, Time, Duration

integration_issues.issue: Appointments show 'Unknown Client' and 'Unassigned' staff - data not properly populated from backend

issues: Date slider working correctly with proper layout
Status badges show with correct color coding
Sections present (Client, Visit History, Appointment Info, Quick Actions) but i18n broken
Quick action buttons (reschedule, cancel, no-show) visible but text not translated

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix i18n translation path - translation file has 'errors.appointments.visitHistory' but code calls 't(appointments.visitHistory)'. Either move translations to top-level 'appointments' key OR update all code to use 'errors.appointments.*' path
HIGH: Verify AppointmentListItem renders client_phone and quick action buttons (Call, WhatsApp) - code has data-testids but buttons not visible in UI
HIGH: Verify WhatsApp button in AppointmentDetailScreen header is rendering - code has data-testid='detail-whatsapp-button' but not visible
MEDIUM: Check why Treatment and Staff info not showing in detail page - appointment data may not have treatment_name/staff_name populated
critical_code_review_comments: i18n structure mismatch: en-US.json has translations at 'errors.appointments.*' but code references 't(appointments.*)' - causing raw keys to display

AppointmentListItem.tsx has proper data-testids and code for client_phone display and quick action buttons, but they may not be rendering due to conditional checks (canCall, canWhatsApp based on userRole)
AppointmentDetailScreen uses useTranslation() hook correctly but translation paths don't match JSON structure
Backend data issue: All appointments show 'Unknown Client' and 'Unassigned' - either client/staff data not linked or API not returning joined data
context_for_next_testing_agent: App accessible via https://appt-quick-actions.preview.emergentagent.com. Login with hareshlekkala@gmail.com / Vishnu432!. After login, switch to 'Clinic Admin' dashboard, then navigate to 'Appointments'. Current appointments show 'Unknown Client' and 'Unassigned' staff. i18n is broken - showing raw translation keys. Quick action buttons (Call, WhatsApp) not rendering in list items despite code having them.
rca_of_the_issue: PRIMARY ROOT CAUSE: Translation file structure mismatch. The en-US.json has appointments translations nested under 'errors.appointments.*' but the React components call t('appointments.*') without the 'errors' prefix. This causes the i18n system to return the raw key when translation not found. SECONDARY: Quick action buttons have RBAC checks (canCall, canWhatsApp based on userRole) which may be blocking render. Appointment data from backend appears incomplete (no client names, staff names, treatment names populated).
